items.caption: Adhd-friendly home organization tips! @slice_cuts #home #homeorganization #declutter #adhd #adhdtips

Minimize subcategories, so instead of having black socks and white socks, just have socks. Keep items where you naturally use them, so instead of having a junk drawer of items, keep pens wherever you write, scissors wherever you use them.
